title: REASONING UNDER CONSTRAINT: HOW BATCH PROMPTING SUPPRESSES OVERTHINKING IN REASONING MODELS
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical efficiency and reasoning behaviors (specifically 'overthinking') in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) like DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI-o1. It evaluates these models using several logical and mathematical benchmarks but does not deal with religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
